zawiya.title: Zawiya
zawiya.about: The zawiya is the mosque of Nujum Al-Huda Institute Center, at 28M Cité des Magistrats, Sud Foire, in Dakar. The five daily prayers are held there, and the Friday khutba is given there.
zawiya.founderP1: It is with great pleasure that I welcome you to this space of the Nujum Al-Huda Institute Center. The zawiya is where we gather for prayer, listening and fellowship.
zawiya.founderP2: Whether you come for the five prayers, the Friday khutba, a lesson, or simply to pause and reflect, you are at home here in Dakar.
zawiya.founderP3: May this site bring you closer to the centre, its prayer times, announcements and community. May Allah accept from us and from you.
points: The five prayers and the iqama are held there.
The Friday khutbas are given there.
The hours follow what the centre announces.
